These are what funding_parent, sceptic, planner_couple and uhnw said they would need before enquiring; all are deferred in brand-facts 'Confirmed business answers'. Raise with the business (Nic for anything priced) and re-run cro-specialist once confirmed.

For the run report, open product decision: search_visitor came for a 'wedding hashtag generator' and the primary keyword implies a tool, but Wedded Wonderland offers none, so the post frames the method as 'a generator you run yourselves' and makes no tool claim. Whether to build a real on-site hashtag generator (for example inside Wonderland Studio) is a product decision for the business. If one ships and is listed in the link map, it would be the natural magnet or secondary for this post and cro-specialist should be re-run.

All four tracked links already exist once each with utm_medium=content and the slug as campaign, primary before secondary, every concierge anchor reads 'Wedded Concierge', and both targets are in the link map, so no link, marker or copy is added and 08-final.md is untouched. Panel cta_reactions: two 'maybe' (funding_parent, planner_couple) and three 'no' (sceptic, search_visitor, uhnw), weighted enquiry 1.6. What the 'maybe' readers want first is a conversation with a real person before any money changes hands, the fee model and commissions, and proof from a real multi-day wedding abroad; all are deferred business details that belong on /wonderland-concierge and are logged for the run report, so nothing can be moved ahead of the CTAs in this post. The magnet is the realistic conversion for search_visitor and is already placed beside the destination ideas.
